why: Empty. The 39 original entries are resolved: 34 layers had their sources on R2 all along (files.fgb in maps.json) and were downloaded and indexed; the remaining 9 were alias layers that never needed their own index -- the guard was checking layer.id and sourceMapId only, and not following aliasTargetLayerId, so it reported a gap that did not exist. Kept as an empty file rather than deleted: the mechanism is still the right one if a real gap appears, and an empty list is a clearer statement than a missing file.
effect: A layer listed here warns. A layer not listed fails the build.
